material_findings.interpretation: This is direct host-local evidence that the known Clay legacy runtime is not quiescent. It is not by itself evidence of provider calls or provider-counter attribution.

steering_decision: Keep FREE_PROVIDER_ADMISSION authority epoch 9.13 unchanged and explicit HARD_OFF; do not create a provider-authority epoch merely for this non-authority steering delta.
Do not restore or invoke the removed PR runtime activation/update paths while HARD_OFF is current. The pull_request self-hosted observable lane is read-only authority inspection only.

Do not grant runtime-quiescence, provider-path, Physical-GRID10, whole-HCU or whole-EntityOS credit before that proof.

external_method_basis.use: GitHub recommends ephemeral self-hosted runners for autoscaling and notes clean one-job environments reduce exposure from previous jobs; this supports keeping the persistent retained PR lane observation-only under HARD_OFF.

A runner executing arbitrary workflow commands can expose repository data or credentials, so a HARD_OFF authority-audit workflow should minimize mutation and provider-capable execution. Method guidance only, not project runtime evidence.
